epochNote: Artemis's first commit landed 2026-07-06 in athena and platform. A repo created before July 2026 was never a candidate for the harness, so scripts/fleet-audit.sh ignores it entirely. A repo created on or after this date must either be athena-managed or be acknowledged below, with a reason.

acknowledged.reason: The instruction compiler itself. It has no .athena/config.json by design: `pnpm compile` with no argument fails with ENOENT on that path, which is the documented expectation, not a defect. A compiler that compiled itself would have to be fresh against its own output before it could be trusted to check anyone else's.

Publishes the reusable workflows, copier templates and security rules the fleet consumes, so it is the source of the harness rather than a consumer of it. It also has no package.json at its root, so the TypeScript stack layer athena would compile in has nothing to describe.

The thin workspace repo. It tracks .gitignore plus owner-facing notes and holds no shippable code; athena and platform live inside its working directory as independent checkouts with their own remotes. There is no build, test or deploy surface here for the harness to gate.
